name: Photo Studio
intro: Photo Studio turns one product photo into a set of styled shots. You pick the looks you want, and your brand's logo and colors can come along.

features.product-image: Start with the product image. Use the button at the top to upload a photo, paste a link, or pick one from your library.
features.brand-selector: The brand selector adds your logo and colors to the shoot. You can also choose no brand logo if you'd rather keep things plain.
features.direction: Direction is optional. Describe the mood or any details the preset doesn't cover, and it gets added on top of the style.
features.resolution: Resolution offers one k, two k or four k. Go higher for print or large banners, and lower for quick drafts.
features.photo-style-presets: The presets come in six categories, such as Beauty, Fashion and Home. Each button shows its style and ratio, and hovering reads what it stages.
features.select-all: Select all picks every preset in a category at once. It's a quick way to compare a whole set of looks.
features.generation-mode: Generation Mode switches between the Brand API and a direct model picker. Use it if you want a different editing model.
features.generate-product-photos: The Generate Product Photos button makes one photo for each preset you selected, working through them a couple at a time.

outro: That's Photo Studio. Add a product, pick your styles, and a whole photoshoot is one click away.
